name: meleeflag-base
description: Control: a new melee map nothing is added to; the World Editor's save keeps the Melee flag (w3i flags 0x4)

name: meleeflag-unit
description: (a) a custom unit (a w3u entry): the World Editor's save and Studio's take the Melee flag off

name: meleeflag-unit-removed
description: (b) a custom unit made and deleted again, so the w3u holds no entry (or is gone): the flag stays

name: meleeflag-trigger-added
description: (c1) a custom trigger next to the unchanged Melee Initialization

args.name: Custom One
args.script:
function Trig_Custom_One_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
endfunction

function InitTrig_Custom_One takes nothing returns nothing
    set gg_trg_Custom_One = CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerAddAction(gg_trg_Custom_One, function Trig_Custom_One_Actions)
endfunction

name: meleeflag-category-off
description: flat.w3x with the trigger category Initialization renamed Setup and the Melee flag cleared (0x9c10): the save turns it back on (branch we-batch-3; c4 measured only keeping it on). Input: tests/fixtures/we-specs/make-melee-valid.mjs category-off. A Studio-made input can't hold the flag off: its pack puts Melee back.

steps.eval: const p = "map/triggers/Initialization/_category.json"; let t = await w3.workspace.readText(p); const re0 = /"name": *"Initialization"/; if (!re0.test(t)) throw new Error('no match for ' + re0); t = t.replace(re0, "\"name\":\"Setup\""); await w3.workspace.writeText(p, t);
